verify-before-use.why: The panel only sees a build that passed the full verify gate (principle 7)

qa-before-use.why: QA verifies the build before the customer round, not alongside it (iteration 3 ran them together)

triage-before-report.why: The report states triage decisions; record triage when patterns and decisions are committed

verify-before-publish.why: main is what the owner playtests: only an exact commit with a green verify gate is published (D-62)

verify-before-merge.why: verify must pass before any merge (principle 12); the pass must be on the merge result

status-refresh-owed.why: A merge owes a T1 refresh, Use and Triage done owe T2 (method/status-page.md); the owner follows the loop on the status page (principle 15)

quality-gate.why: An iteration closes through Gate with a recorded quality scorecard on the code being closed (D-78, kit/evaluate.mjs --record); a release candidate additionally needs the verdict met (D-79)

t3-before-plan.why: The finished iteration is closed on the status page (T3: summary, consumption, goals, journal) before the next Plan

design-review-before-merge.why: Merges that touch the UI need the UX Designer and Art Director's review of the built screen at every breakpoint (screenshots plus the layout audit), D-81
